evidence: Touches src/index/ headers and implementations to eliminate process-global secondary index instances (g_txindex, g_txospenderindex, etc.) and transition ownership to NodeContext.
rationale: Moves index ownership out of process-wide static globals and into NodeContext, improving encapsulation and easing testing with multiple node instances. While this is primarily an architectural refactor rather than a data integrity or performance improvement, eliminating global index state provides clear architectural value.
